metadata.title: Zay Jones - Back to practice squad
metadata.description: Jones reverted to the Cardinals' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Jones was elevated to the Cardinals' active roster for Week 10 against the Rams on Sunday. He played seven offensive snaps and failed to haul in his lone target from Carson Beck, and Jones also recorded a tackle on linebacker Wesley Bailey midway through the third quarter in what was a 34-6 loss for Arizona. Michael Wilson (neck), Kendrick Bourne (lower leg) and Jalen Brooks (wrist) are all on season-ending IR, so Jones could be elevated to the Cardinals' active roster for Week 11 against the Chiefs on Nov. 22.

metadata.title: Zay Jones - Set for 2026 debut Week 10
metadata.description: Jones was elevated from Arizona's practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Jones signed with the Cardinals' practice squad Oct. 28, and this is his first elevation since joining the organization. The veteran wideout could immediately slide into a major role in Arizona's passing game among a depleted wideout corps that has lost Michael Wilson (neck) and Kendrick Bourne (tibia) for the season. Jones spent the past two campaigns with the Cardinals, and he caught 12 passes (on 18 targets) for 182 yards over eight games last year.

metadata.title: Zay Jones elevated from Cardinals practice squad
metadata.description: The Cardinals elevated WR Zay Jones from their practice squad for Sunday's game against the Rams.
metadata.analysis: Jones will add depth for a banged up Cardinals wide receiver room. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Zay Jones Elevated to Active Roster for Week 10
metadata.description: Arizona Cardinals wide receiver Zay Jones has been elevated from the practice squad to the active roster for Sunday's Week 10 contest against the Los Angeles Rams, according to Darren Urban of the team's official website. Jones will offer a major reinforcement for a Cardinals team that has experienced several significant losses at the wide receiver position. Arizona traded away Marvin Harrison Jr. earlier this season, and they recently placed Michael Wilson (neck) and Kendrick Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve with season-ending injuries. Jones has yet to play an offensive snap this season, but that could change Sunday with both Wilson and Bourne sidelined. With that being said, he remains off the fantasy radar in his role behind Reggie Virgil, Simi Fehoko, and Devin Duvernay. He could also face some adversity while catching passes from inexperienced rookie quarterback Carson Beck, who is making his NFL debut in Week 10.

metadata.title: Zay Jones - New opportunity with Arizona
metadata.description: The Cardinals signed Jones to the practice squad Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Jones spent the final week of training camp with the Texans but was unable to crack the 53-man roster. He's now with the Cardinals as a member of the practice squad and would be a candidate for elevation to the active roster if Arizona was in need of depth at wide receiver. Jones played in eight regular-season games for the Cardinals in 2025 before being placed on injured reserve in mid-November due to an Achilles injury.

metadata.title: Zay Jones signs with Cardinals
metadata.description: The Cardinals signed WR Zay Jones to their practice squad.
metadata.analysis: Jones will add depth in the wide receiver room for Arizona. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Zay Jones Signing with Cardinals
metadata.description: Veteran wide receiver Zay Jones is signing with the Arizona Cardinals, per Jordan Schultz of The Schultz Report. Jones appeared in eight games with Arizona in 2025, recording 12 catches for 183 yards on 18 targets. However, he suffered a season-ending torn Achilles tendon in Week 10 and has yet to play in an NFL game since. In Arizona, Jones should provide a much-needed downfield field-stretcher, which the team has lacked since trading wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. to the Houston Texans in early October. While Jones' presence could take a few targets away from Cardinals wide receiver Michael Wilson and tight end Trey McBride, it could ultimately help relieve some defensive attention from Arizona's top options in the passing game.

metadata.title: Zay Jones - Let go by Houston
metadata.description: Jones was released by the Texans on Sunday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
metadata.analysis: Jones signed with Houston on Aug. 21 after completing a tryout with the team. The wide receiver caught one of three targets for six yards in the Texans' 16-13 loss to the Panthers in their preseason finale. Jones caught 12 of 18 targets for 183 yards over eight regular-season contests with Arizona in 2025 before ending the season on injured reserve with an Achilles tear that he suffered in Week 10. Now fully healthy, Jones will likely get another shot with a new squad in 2026.

metadata.title: Zay Jones released by Texans
metadata.description: The Texans released WR Zay Jones.
metadata.analysis: Jones signed with Houston earlier in August. He will seek a depth role with another team heading into the season.

metadata.title: Zay Jones - Joining forces with Texans
metadata.description: Jones is signing a contract with the Texans after completing a tryout with the team Friday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Jones and Sterling Shepard are joining Houston after the Texans lost Jayden Higgins for the season due to a torn ACL. In eight regular-season contests with the Cardinals in 2025, Jones hauled in 12 of 18 targets for 183 yards and no touchdowns.
